summary.text: Steve Howe is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 71 who has represented the district since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Howe, listed on Ballotpedia as Steven Howe, is a Salina business owner who chairs the House Higher Education Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steve Howe, listed on Ballotpedia as Steven Howe, graduated from Manhattan High School and earned a bachelor's degree in speech from Kansas State University in 2002.
His career experience includes working as a teacher and co-owning the Tamara Howe School of Dance.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Howe said he grew up on a small family farm in southwest Riley County and, after a legislative internship on Capitol Hill, spent 13 years working for two members of Congress.
He said he and his wife Tamara have lived in Salina for 21 years and are raising five children, and that they own the Tamara Howe School of Dance and Howe Pest Management.
Howe succeeded Diana Dierks in the District 71 seat and took office on January 11, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee and chairs the Higher Education Budget Committee.
In the same survey, Howe described his campaign messages as limited government, stewardship of tax dollars and meeting core responsibilities, including statutory special education funding.
He faces Democrat Jerry Lonergan in the general election.
